","audio/music/aim_tension_loop.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,","audio/music/victory_sting.mp3":"data:audio/mpeg;base64,"};
const img={};const images={hero:'assets/hero_base.png',bow:'assets/hero_bow.png',e0:'assets/enemy0.png',e1:'assets/enemy1.png',e2:'assets/enemy2.png',e3:'assets/enemy3.png',bg0:'assets/bg0.jpg',bg1:'assets/bg1.jpg',bg2:'assets/bg2.jpg',bg3:'assets/bg3.jpg'};for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(images)){img[k]=new Image();img[k].src=IMAGE_URL[v]||v}
class Sound{constructor(){this.started=false;this.muted=false;this.bgm=.3;this.sfx=.85;this.current=null;this.ambience=null;this.players=[];this.aiming=false;this.musicKey='';this.index=0;this.duckFactor=1;this.duckSerial=0;}start(){this.started=true;this.playMusic('battle_loop');this.playAmbient()}
 playMusic(key){if(!this.started)return;if(key===this.musicKey)return;this.musicKey=key;if(this.current){const old=this.current;const oldvol=old.volume;let i=0;const fade=()=>{if(old.paused)return;i++;old.volume=Math.max(0,oldvol*(1-i/14));if(i>=14){old.pause();old.currentTime=0}else setTimeout(fade,28)};fade()};let a=new Audio(AUDIO_URL['audio/music/'+key+'.mp3']);a.loop=!key.includes('sting');a.preload='auto';a.volume=this.muted?0:(this.bgm*(this.aiming?.34:1)*this.duckFactor);a.play().catch(()=>{});this.current=a;
 if(key==='victory_sting'||key==='defeat_sting'){a.addEventListener('ended',()=>{if(this.musicKey===key)this.playMusic('battle_loop')},{once:true})}}
 playAmbient(){this.ambience=new Audio(AUDIO_URL['audio/music/valley_ambience.mp3']);this.ambience.loop=true;this.ambience.volume=this.muted?0:0.13;this.ambience.play().catch(()=>{})}
 duck(factor,time){this.duckFactor=factor;this.refresh();const num=++this.duckSerial;setTimeout(()=>{if(num===this.duckSerial){this.duckFactor=1;this.refresh()}},time)}
 setAim(v){this.aiming=v;this.refresh()}
 refresh(){if(this.current)this.current.volume=this.muted?0:(this.bgm*(this.aiming?.36:1)*this.duckFactor);if(this.ambience)this.ambience.volume=this.muted?0:.13}
 s(name,vol=1){if(!this.started||this.muted)return;if(name==='headshot')this.duck(.18,290);else if(name==='hell_pierce')this.duck(.28,1100);else if(name==='rain_start')this.duck(.46,1450);const n=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2);let src='audio/sfx/'+name+'_'+('0'+n).slice(-2)+'.mp3';let a=new Audio(AUDIO_URL[src]);a.preload='auto';a.volume=clamp(this.sfx*vol,0,1);this.players.push(a);a.addEventListener('ended',()=>{let idx=this.players.indexOf(a);if(idx>=0)this.players.splice(idx,1)},{once:true});a.play().catch(()=>{});if(this.players.length>24){let p=this.players.shift();p.pause()}}
}
let audio=new Sound();
let game={started:false,frame:0,level:1,turn:1,hp:180,shots:0,score:0,aimAngle:.34,aimSpeed:850,isAiming:false,projectiles:[],enemies:[],platforms:[],particles:[],rings:[],texts:[],screenShake:0,flash:0,collapse:0,collapseEnd:0,bg:0,skillRain:0,buttonsLock:false,moveFx:0,invulnerable:0,hitStop:0};const origin={x:233,y:447};const gravity=650;
function reset(all=true){if(all){game.level=1;game.hp=180;game.score=0;game.turn=1;}game.shots=0;game.aimAngle=.34;game.aimSpeed=850;game.isAiming=false;game.projectiles=[];game.particles=[];game.texts=[];game.flash=0;game.collapse=0;game.collapseEnd=0;game.screenShake=0;game.bg=Math.floor((game.level-1)/5)%4;
 game.platforms=[{x:0,y:550,w:465,h:130,hp:999,kind:'ground',seed:1},{x:430,y:610,w:230,h:70,hp:999,kind:'ground',seed:2},{x:675,y:514,w:245,h:37,hp:3,kind:'rock',seed:5},{x:908,y:432,w:260,h:40,hp:3,kind:'rock',seed:4},{x:805,y:581,w:390,h:94,hp:5,kind:'rock',seed:6}];
 const ty=[{x:760,foot:514,kind:0},{x:1033,foot:432,kind:1},{x:924,foot:581,kind:2}];game.enemies=ty.map((p,i)=>({...p,live:true,hp:i===2?2:1,dy:0,falling:false,rot:0,hit:0,id:i}));setText('산적 3명을 처치하거나 지형을 무너뜨려 보세요.');refreshHud()}
function nextLevel(){game.level++;if(game.level>5){game.level=1;game.hp=180;}reset(false);game.bg=(game.level-1)%4;setText('승리! 다음 전장으로 이동했습니다.');audio.playMusic(game.level%5===0?'boss_loop':'battle_loop')}
function refreshHud(){$('heroHpText').textContent=`${game.hp} / 180`;$('hpFill').style.width=(100*game.hp/180)+'%';let alive=game.enemies.filter(e=>e.live).length;$('enemyLabel').textContent=`산적 ${alive}명`;$('enemyFill').style.width=(100*alive/3)+'%';$('stageTag').textContent=`제1장 · ${game.bg===0?'황혼의 계곡':game.bg===1?'청월림':game.bg===2?'설산 고원':'혈월 요새'} · ${String(game.level).padStart(2,'0')}/05`;$('turnLabel').textContent=`${game.turn}턴 · 사운드 시연`;$('stageLabel').textContent='헤드샷 / 지형 파괴 / 궁극기';}
function setText(s,t=2.8){$('feedback').textContent=s;$('status').textContent=s;game.textTimeout=performance.now()/1000+t}
function explosion(x,y,n,power=1,palette=['#f9d399','#d9b181','#978477','#48494a']){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let angle=rand(-Math.PI,Math.PI),sp=rand(80,420)*power;game.particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*sp,vy:Math.sin(angle)*sp-rand(60,160),life:rand(.45,1.7),ttl:1.7,r:rand(2,11)*power,c:palette[i%palette.length],dust:Math.random()<.4})}game.rings.push({x,y,r:6,life:.43,power});game.flash=Math.max(game.flash,.09*power);game.screenShake=Math.max(game.screenShake,17*power)}
function shake(power){game.screenShake=Math.max(game.screenShake,power*Number($('shakeV').value)/100)}
function impact(x,y,kind){let s=kind==='headshot'?'HEADSHOT!':kind==='body'?'명중!':kind==='rock'?'암반 파괴!':'지형 붕괴';game.texts.push({x,y,t:s,life:1.35,c:kind==='headshot'?'#ffe188':kind==='body'?'#fff0d3':'#f4c88c'});}
function enemyHit(e,head=false){if(!e.live)return; e.hit=0.3;e.hp-=head?5:1;let y=head?e.foot-102:e.foot-64;audio.s(head?'headshot':'hit_body',head?1:.89);explosion(e.x,y,head?22:14,head?1.6:.8,head?['#fff4cd','#f7b961','#922c32','#e3cfb8']:['#f4c79a','#c97d5e','#8c383d','#dbb297']);shake(head?42:15);if(head){game.hitStop=.075;game.flash=Math.max(game.flash,.19)}impact(e.x,y,head?'headshot':'body');setText(head?'치명적인 헤드샷!':'화살이 명중했습니다!');if(e.hp<=0){e.live=false;e.falling=true;e.dy=-90;audio.s('enemy_death',.25);game.score+=head?250:100;setTimeout(()=>checkClear(),1200)}refreshHud();}
function rockImpact(p,x,y,damage=1){if(p.kind==='ground'){audio.s('rock_crack',.46);explosion(x,y,8,.4);return;} p.hp-=damage;audio.s('rock_crack',1);explosion(x,y,18,1.15);shake(22);impact(x,y,'rock');setText('암석 균열! 지형 붕괴를 노리세요.');if(p.hp<=0){const i=game.platforms.indexOf(p);if(i>=0)game.platforms.splice(i,1);collapseAt(x+p.w*.28,y,p.w>270);for(const e of game.enemies)if(e.live&&e.x>=p.x-5&&e.x<=p.x+p.w+5&&Math.abs(e.foot-y)<32){e.live=false;e.falling=true;audio.s('enemy_death',.8);game.score+=150}setTimeout(()=>checkClear(),1200)}refreshHud();}
function collapseAt(x,y,big=true){audio.s('mountain_collapse',big?1:.73);audio.s('debris',.48);setTimeout(()=>audio.s('debris',.5),650);setTimeout(()=>audio.s('rock_crack',.42),1120);explosion(x,y,big?120:65,big?2.6:1.8,['#e5cfaf','#b4a398','#89766a','#4d4541','#ecddc0']);shake(big?53:34);game.collapse=Math.max(game.collapse,big?5.7:3);game.collapseEnd=performance.now()/1000+game.collapse;game.flash=.22;game.rings.push({x,y,r:8,life:.75,power:big?3:2});setText(big?'산맥이 무너진다! 대규모 붕괴!':'지형이 붕괴했습니다!',4.7);}
function checkClear(){if(game.started&&game.enemies.every(e=>!e.live)){audio.playMusic('victory_sting');setText('전장 제압 완료! 다음 전장으로 이동합니다.',5);setTimeout(()=>{if(game.started&&game.enemies.every(e=>!e.live))nextLevel()},4300)}}
function arrowShot(angle=game.aimAngle,speed=game.aimSpeed,skill=false){if(!game.started)return;game.isAiming=false;audio.setAim(false);let a={x:origin.x,y:origin.y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:-Math.sin(angle)*speed,life:0,trail:[],skill};game.projectiles.push(a);game.turn++;game.shots++;game.aimAngle=angle;game.aimSpeed=speed;audio.s('bow_release',.9);setTimeout(()=>audio.s('arrow_fly',.6),70);game.moveFx=.12;refreshHud();}
function ballisticTo(x,y,speed=860){const dx=x-origin.x,dy=origin.y-y;const v2=speed*speed;let disc=v2*v2-gravity*(gravity*dx*dx+2*dy*v2);if(disc<0){speed=1100;let v22=speed*speed;disc=Math.max(0,v22*v22-gravity*(gravity*dx*dx+2*dy*v22))}return{angle:clamp(Math.atan((speed*speed-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,disc)))/(gravity*dx)),.04,1.4),speed};}
function targetShot(x,y){let a=ballisticTo(x,y,950);arrowShot(a.angle,a.speed)}
function headTest(){const e=game.enemies.find(e=>e.live);if(!e){reset(false);return}targetShot(e.x,e.foot-102)}
function bodyTest(){const e=game.enemies.find(e=>e.live);if(!e){reset(false);return}targetShot(e.x,e.foot-61)}
function crackTest(){const p=game.platforms.find(p=>p.kind==='rock');if(!p){reset(false);return}targetShot(p.x+p.w*.36,p.y+5)}
function landslide(){let p=game.platforms.find(p=>p.kind==='rock');if(p){p.hp=0;rockImpact(p,p.x+p.w*.47,p.y,2);}else collapseAt(830,480,true)}
function hell(){if(!game.started)return;audio.playMusic('boss_loop');audio.s('skill_charge',.86);setText('地獄破滅矢 · 지옥파멸시',4);game.flash=.17;setTimeout(()=>{audio.s('hell_pierce',1);game.flash=Math.max(game.flash,.32);shake(34);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){setTimeout(()=>{let x=550+i*90;explosion(x,455+Math.sin(i)*56,24,1.15,['#fff4e4','#fad68a','#ef7347','#4b352d']);if(i===3)collapseAt(790,530,true)},i*105)}for(const e of game.enemies)if(e.live)enemyHit(e,false);game.rings.push({x:440,y:430,r:15,life:.8,power:3.5})},450)}
function rain(){if(!game.started)return;audio.s('rain_start',.94);game.flash=Math.max(game.flash,.23);shake(18);setText('時雨天下 · 시우천하!',4.3);for(let i=0;i<24;i++){setTimeout(()=>{const x=690+Math.random()*450,y=315+Math.random()*260;game.projectiles.push({x,y:-40,vx:-90,vy:1100,life:0,trail:[],skill:'rain',tx:x,ty:y});if(i%3===0)audio.s('rain_impact',.53)},i*85)}}
function segCirc(x1,y1,x2,y2,cx,cy,r){const vx=x2-x1,vy=y2-y1;const f=clamp(((cx-x1)*vx+(cy-y1)*vy)/(vx*vx+vy*vy||1),0,1);return Math.hypot(x1+f*vx-cx,y1+f*vy-cy)<r}
function update(dt){if(game.hitStop>0){game.hitStop-=dt;return;}game.frame+=dt;game.moveFx=Math.max(0,game.moveFx-dt);game.flash=Math.max(0,game.flash-dt);game.screenShake*=Math.pow(.06,dt*2.6);if(game.screenShake<.1)game.screenShake=0;const tnow=performance.now()/1000;if(game.collapseEnd>tnow){game.collapse=game.collapseEnd-tnow;if(Math.random()<dt*15){let x=rand(700,1150),y=rand(490,630);explosion(x,y,3,.65)}}else game.collapse=0;
 for(const e of game.enemies){e.hit=Math.max(0,e.hit-dt);if(e.falling){e.dy+=550*dt;e.foot+=e.dy*dt;e.rot+=dt*3;}}
 for(let ai=game.projectiles.length-1;ai>=0;ai--){const a=game.projectiles[ai],ox=a.x,oy=a.y;const steps=5;let remove=false;for(let s=0;s<steps;s++){let st=dt/steps;a.vy+=gravity*st*(a.skill==='rain'?.22:1);a.x+=a.vx*st;a.y+=a.vy*st;a.life+=st;if(a.skill==='rain'&&a.y>=a.ty){audio.s('rain_impact',.36);explosion(a.x,a.y,10,.65);for(const e of game.enemies)if(e.live&&Math.abs(e.x-a.x)<68){enemyHit(e,false)}remove=true;break;}
 for(const e of game.enemies)if(e.live){if(segCirc(ox,oy,a.x,a.y,e.x,e.foot-104,24)){enemyHit(e,true);remove=true;break}if(segCirc(ox,oy,a.x,a.y,e.x,e.foot-59,37)){enemyHit(e,false);remove=true;break}}if(remove)break;
 for(const p of game.platforms){if(p.kind==='ground'&&a.x<p.x)continue;if(a.x>p.x&&a.x<p.x+p.w&&a.y>p.y&&a.y<p.y+p.h){rockImpact(p,a.x,a.y,1);remove=true;break}}if(remove)break;}
 a.trail.push({x:a.x,y:a.y});if(a.trail.length>13)a.trail.shift();if(a.life>3.2||a.x>W+120||a.y>H+150)remove=true;if(remove)game.projectiles.splice(ai,1)}
 for(let i=game.particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=game.particles[i];p.life-=dt;if(p.life<0){game.particles.splice(i,1);continue}p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=(p.dust?120:560)*dt;p.vx*=Math.pow(.65,dt)}
 for(let i=game.texts.length-1;i>=0;i--){const t=game.texts[i];t.life-=dt;t.y-=35*dt;if(t.life<0)game.texts.splice(i,1)}for(let i=game.rings.length-1;i>=0;i--){let r=game.rings[i];r.life-=dt;r.r+=dt*190*r.power;if(r.life<0)game.rings.splice(i,1)}
 if(!game.isAiming&&audio.aiming)audio.setAim(false);}
function platform(p){ctx.save();const g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,p.y,0,p.y+p.h);if(p.kind==='rock'){g.addColorStop(0,'#ad8f66');g.addColorStop(.15,'#665b52');g.addColorStop(.85,'#292c30');g.addColorStop(1,'#1b1d21')}else{g.addColorStop(0,'#827056');g.addColorStop(.16,'#4f453b');g.addColorStop(1,'#1d2224')};ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,p.w,p.h+50);ctx.strokeStyle='#eac08c';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(p.x+p.w,p.y);ctx.stroke();ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeStyle='#161c21';for(let i=0;i<p.w;i+=36){let n=Math.sin(i*.2+p.seed)*8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x+i,p.y+7);ctx.lineTo(p.x+i+n,p.y+rand(25,46));ctx.stroke()}for(let i=0;i<14;i++){let x=p.x+(i*53+31)%p.w,y=p.y+17+(i*21)%(p.h+60);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(15,18,20,.2)';ctx.fillRect(x,y,rand(10,48),rand(3,9))}ctx.restore()}
function drawHero(){const image=img.hero;if(!image.complete)return;ctx.save();const recoil=game.moveFx*60;ctx.translate(117,354+recoil);ctx.drawImage(image,0,0,152,165);ctx.restore();if(img.bow.complete){ctx.save();ctx.translate(origin.x-5,origin.y);ctx.rotate(-game.aimAngle*.5);ctx.drawImage(img.bow,-13,-66,31,129);ctx.restore()}}
function drawEnemies(){for(const e of game.enemies){if(!e.live&&!e.falling)continue;if(e.foot>840)continue;const image=img['e'+e.kind];if(!image.complete)continue;ctx.save();ctx.translate(e.x,e.foot+(e.hit>0?rand(-2,2):Math.sin(game.frame*2+e.id)*1.2));ctx.rotate(e.falling?e.rot:0);if(e.hit>0){ctx.shadowColor='#e8473d';ctx.shadowBlur=25}ctx.drawImage(image,-67,-160,134,160);ctx.restore()}}
function render(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.save();const power=game.screenShake*Number($('shakeV').value)/100;ctx.translate((Math.random()-.5)*power,(Math.random()-.5)*power);const b=img['bg'+game.bg];if(b.complete){ctx.drawImage(b,0,0,W,H)}else{ctx.fillStyle='#333435';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}ctx.fillStyle='rgba(13,18,21,.22)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);let fog=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,340,0,670);fog.addColorStop(0,'rgba(28,28,30,0)');fog.addColorStop(1,'rgba(17,19,23,.57)');ctx.fillStyle=fog;ctx.fillRect(0,320,1200,360);
 for(const p of game.platforms)platform(p);drawEnemies();drawHero();
 // animated dust drift above terrain
 for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(233,210,180,.055)';const x=(i*120+game.frame*(6+i%3*3))%1400-100;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,440+i%4*49,85,7,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 if(game.isAiming){let x=origin.x,y=origin.y,vx=Math.cos(game.aimAngle)*game.aimSpeed,vy=-Math.sin(game.aimAngle)*game.aimSpeed;for(let i=0;i<39;i++){let t=i*.043,px=x+vx*t,py=y+vy*t+gravity*t*t*.5;if(px>1190||py>680)break;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,clamp(4-i*.035,1.8,4),0,6.283);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,222,164,${.78-i*.013})`;ctx.fill()}ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#ffe1aa';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.setLineDash([7,8]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(origin.x,origin.y,21,0,6.28);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
 for(const a of game.projectiles){ctx.save();ctx.lineCap='round';for(let i=1;i<a.trail.length;i++){const p=a.trail[i-1],q=a.trail[i];ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${a.skill==='rain'?'185,221,249':'255,201,112'},${i/a.trail.length*.53})`;ctx.lineWidth=i/a.trail.length*4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(q.x,q.y);ctx.stroke()}ctx.translate(a.x,a.y);ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(a.vy,a.vx));ctx.fillStyle='#fff0d0';ctx.fillRect(-27,-1.4,33,2.8);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(7,0);ctx.lineTo(-3,-5);ctx.lineTo(-3,5);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#ffddb2';ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
 for(const p of game.particles){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life/1.1,0,.9);ctx.fillStyle=p.c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*(p.dust?1+(1-p.life/1.7)*1.8:1),0,6.29);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
 for(const r of game.rings){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,211,162,${r.life*.85})`;ctx.lineWidth=clamp(r.power*2,1,8);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(r.x,r.y,r.r,0,6.29);ctx.stroke()}
 for(const t of game.texts){ctx.save();ctx.font='900 28px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.strokeStyle='#101010';ctx.strokeText(t.t,t.x,t.y);ctx.fillStyle=t.c;ctx.fillText(t.t,t.x,t.y);ctx.restore()}
 if(game.collapse>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(224,211,194,${Math.min(.17,game.collapse*.035)})`;ctx.fillRect(600,400,600,275)}if(game.flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,233,191,${Math.min(.32,game.flash)})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}ctx.restore();
 if(!game.started){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(7,10,16,.27)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)} }
let then=performance.now();function loop(now){const dt=clamp((now-then)/1000,.001,.045);then=now;if(game.started)update(dt);render();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}reset();requestAnimationFrame(loop);
function touchXY(ev){let r=C.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:(ev.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width,y:(ev.clientY-r.top)*H/r.height}}
let pressed=null,moved=false;C.addEventListener('pointerdown',ev=>{if(!game.started)return;ev.preventDefault();C.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);pressed=touchXY(ev);moved=false;game.isAiming=true;audio.setAim(true);audio.s('bow_draw',.43);game.aimAngle=clamp(Math.atan2(origin.y-pressed.y,pressed.x-origin.x),.05,1.35)});C.addEventListener('pointermove',ev=>{if(!game.started||!pressed)return;let xy=touchXY(ev);moved=moved||Math.hypot(xy.x-pressed.x,xy.y-pressed.y)>15;game.aimAngle=clamp(Math.atan2(origin.y-xy.y,xy.x-origin.x),.05,1.4);game.aimSpeed=clamp(760+Math.hypot(xy.x-origin.x,xy.y-origin.y)*.19,760,1010)});C.addEventListener('pointerup',ev=>{if(!game.started||!pressed)return;const p=touchXY(ev);const target=game.enemies.find(e=>e.live&&Math.abs(p.x-e.x)<74&&p.y>e.foot-170&&p.y<e.foot+35);if(!moved&&target){const a=ballisticTo(p.x,p.y<target.foot-75?target.foot-102:target.foot-61,950);arrowShot(a.angle,a.speed)}else arrowShot(game.aimAngle,game.aimSpeed);pressed=null;game.isAiming=false;audio.setAim(false)});C.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{pressed=null;game.isAiming=false;audio.setAim(false)});
function requireStart(f){return()=>{if(!game.started){setText('먼저 전투 시작 버튼을 눌러 주세요.');return}f()}};
$('startBtn').onclick=()=>{game.started=true;audio.start();$('cover').style.display='none';reset();setText('화면을 터치하여 조준하고 화살을 발사하세요!');};$('btnHead').onclick=requireStart(headTest);$('btnBody').onclick=requireStart(bodyTest);$('btnCrack').onclick=requireStart(crackTest);$('btnCollapse').onclick=requireStart(landslide);$('btnHell').onclick=requireStart(hell);$('btnRain').onclick=requireStart(rain);$('btnReset').onclick=requireStart(()=>{reset();audio.playMusic('battle_loop')});$('btnMute').onclick=()=>{audio.muted=!audio.muted;audio.refresh();$('btnMute').textContent=audio.muted?'🔇 음소거':'🔊 소리 켜짐';};$('musicV').oninput=e=>{audio.bgm=Number(e.target.value)/100;audio.refresh()};$('sfxV').oninput=e=>audio.sfx=Number(e.target.value)/100;
document.addEventListener('keydown',ev=>{if(!game.started)return;if(ev.code==='Space'){ev.preventDefault();arrowShot()}else if(ev.key==='1')headTest();else if(ev.key==='2')landslide();else if(ev.key==='3')hell();else if(ev.key==='4')rain()});
</script>
</body>
</html>
